networks.name: invoice_shopfront_assistant
networks.description: Answers counter questions for a Rawalpindi battery and solar shop: catalogue stock and prices from the shop's own published data, FBR digital-invoicing questions from a deterministic rules action carrying every citation, and the text of the law from a rules authority published on a different website.
sample_queries: Do you have the 150Ah tubular battery in stock right now, and what is it today?
I sold a battery to a registered dealer yesterday on a digital invoice - can I still cancel it and how?
Do I need to put the buyer's NTN on this bill, or is a name enough?
Which channel should this sale go through, POS or Digital Invoicing?

llm_router.note: The published default path is the reference runtime's deterministic mock: the network runs with no key and no server, which is what makes every interoperability claim on the Conformance page reproducible by a judge who has not set anything up. Bring your own key switches to a real OpenRouter-compatible router in the same runtime. No publisher-funded inference endpoint is offered, so no key of ours exists to leak.

peer_policy.note: Public agent sites are reachable like web pages; credentials and capabilities do not transfer. The denied origin is a published fixture so the 'stop a denied origin' interoperability check has a real destination to refuse; it is denied rather than absent, which is the stronger test.

actions.note: Local site actions only. They run in this page's JavaScript against this page's own origin; no cross-site action transport is claimed.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host. Grounded capability here is a registered local site action and a published data file, which spec 2.1 lists as equally valid.

specification: Open Agentic Web MVP Profile 0.2, 6 November 2026

vendored_runtime.note: /runtime on this origin is the sponsor's reference implementation, copied verbatim and integrity-checked. It is not entrant code.
